central PASS is not asset-rights or platform acceptance

engine repository tasks use AGENTS.md and actual package owners; new Studio game-local ludory-* skills require their individual scope/authorization

global save-systems and visual-novel cannot redefine native persistence, Back semantics or invent save migration
steam-publish and itch-publish do not substitute VK/Yandex SDK, asset-rights, owner approval, and native Release gates
